{{Quote|I wonder what happened to G2-5T, my relief droid. Good looking. Looks just like me. Gosh, I hope he didn't get sacked!|G2-9T|<ref name="The Adventures Continue" />}}
'''G2-5T''' was a [[Gender/Legends|masculine]] [[G2 repair droid/Legends|G2 repair droid]] that screened luggage in [[Spaceport THX1138]]'s [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] terminal. Shortly before the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138|raid]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]<ref name="The Adventures Continue" /> around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Convenient Daily Departures">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]] wondered what had happened to G2-5T, who he expected to relieve him. As he worried that G2-5T had been sacked, a disassembled G2 droid could be seen inside a piece of luggage passing through the scanner behind him.<ref name="The Adventures Continue" />
